issue: The previous AcceptanceSolver labeled safe-coloring template moves as equal game-theoretic values; random selection could enter a forced loss.

fix.runtime: Persistent native alpha-beta server; one transposition table is reused for every move in a game.
fix.selection_rule: Random selection is restricted to native moves whose exact child value equals the exact current value.
fix.fallback: No heuristic or coloring-template fallback is exposed as equal-value in pygame, analyze, or self-play.

alphazero_assistance: Not used. Exhaustive native search supplies stronger deterministic WDL ground truth for this regression.
